description: Samsite demo — stand a fresh session up end-to-end: seed the plugin GRIFT (AWS/GitHub/KSI/samsite pages + schedules), then fire the collectors that pull the live world in. Seed order is INSTALLED_APPS order; collector order matters: samsite-compliance reads aws_account nodes (boto3) AND content-matches github_workflow nodes (github_core), so both must run before it.

plugins.note: Package-mode (tap_plugin.administrivia), 2026-07-01. TAP admin pages + grid landing + cares administrivia; seeded in population.

Package-mode (tap_plugin.lotr), 2026-07-01. Install-only: the demo/test-fixture vocabulary lotr's own suites + tap_web/tap_grid feature tests use as a concrete plugin example; installed so any env that boots samsite keeps tap_plugin.lotr importable in the test suite. NOT seeded — Middle-earth data has no place in this customer-demo profile.

EVICTED to notgeorge/tap-plugin-computing-core @ v0.1.0 (2026-07-03) — git-installed via authed source. Vendor-neutral computing-primitive dimension; seeded in population. Monorepo plugins/computing_core/ retained as the offline dev/test source (removal deferred with the wheelhouse).

EVICTED to notgeorge/tap-plugin-roscale @ v0.1.0 (2026-07-03) — git-installed via authed source. Install-only: registers the OSCAL workbench panel types samsite consumes; no grift seed, no collector. Monorepo copy retained as offline dev/test source (removal deferred with the wheelhouse).

EVICTED to notgeorge/tap-plugin-aws-core (2026-07-03) — git-installed via authed source. Pinned @ v0.1.1 (2026-07-06: cross-account STS AssumeRole credential kind + partner handoff). Tier-0 boto3 dep. AWS dimension + boto3 collector; seeded + fired in population. Monorepo copy retained as offline dev/test source; released direct-to-repo pending a scripted plugin-release path.

EVICTED to notgeorge/tap-plugin-sigstore-core @ v0.1.0 (2026-07-03) — git-installed via authed source. Tier-0 sigstore dep. Install-only library: samsite compliance_collector consumes its verify/decompose helpers + models. Monorepo copy retained as offline dev/test source.

EVICTED to notgeorge/tap-plugin-github-core @ v0.1.0 (2026-07-03) — git-installed via authed source. Tier-0 PyYAML dep. AWS/GitHub Actions plumbing + the github collector. Monorepo copy retained as offline dev/test source.

First leaf EVICTED from the monorepo (2026-07-03): pulled at boot from its own repo (notgeorge/tap-plugin-fedramp-20x-ksi) via authed git source — the github-plugins-ro PAT (scope tap_plugins.source) fed through GIT_ASKPASS, never in the URL. rev pinned to the immutable tag v0.1.1 (commit 27f0c97), which ships the ksi-seed cold-boot id fix; v0.1.0 shipped a stale seed (type-sweep hash fallout) that dangled on cold boot. samsite boots now depend on the repo + PAT + network — the intended demo-profile behavior. Reversible: flip back to {type:editable, path:plugins/fedramp_20x_ksi} to use the monorepo copy. The monorepo plugins/fedramp_20x_ksi/ tree stays in place until this boot-verifies, then is removed (per the eviction recipe).

Package-mode (tap_plugin.samsite), 2026-07-01. Last of the samsite set to migrate; the demo integration surface. DEPENDS ON the four plugins above at import time (compliance_collector + panels import tap_plugin.{sigstore_core,github_core,roscale} and read aws_core nodes) — listed last so its cross-plugin (Tier-1/2) deps are installed first. The manifest depends_on schema + boot consistency gate that would enforce this are deferred (declare-now, resolver-later); today the ordering here satisfies it structurally.

Package-mode (tap_plugin.grid_fixtures). Install-only: the neutral grid_fixtures__* node/edge vocabulary the core suites build fixtures from. No GRIFT seed, no cross-plugin deps. (gryphon_playground, which depends_on it, is NOT installed in this customer-demo profile — the Gryphon test corpus stands up via its own in-package boot records, tap_plugin/gryphon_playground/boot/{playground,soak}.boot.json, selected by a bootstrap pointer.)

steps.note: TAP admin pages + grid landing + cares administrivia.
AWS dimension + region reference data the boto3 collector lands resources into.
Samsite keystone, landing + compliance pages, per-type viewers, and the collector schedules.
FedRAMP 20x KSI dimension, catalog seed, compliance/profile pages, schedule.
AWS resource graph (Route53/CloudFront/S3/Lambda/IAM/...) + the aws_account node the boundary membership depends on. A full multi-region pull can run well past the 90s default.
GitHub repository / Actions data behind the repo landing page.
Refresh the FedRAMP 20x KSI catalog (HTTPS, no credentials).

Signed /.well-known/ compliance artifacts (OSCAL SSP/POA&M, KSI signal, VDR). Fetches 5 artifacts + verifies sigstore signatures, so it gets a generous timeout. MUST run after boto3 (synthesizes SCOPED_TO_BOUNDARY membership from the aws_account nodes) AND after github_core (sigstore_link resolves the signing github_workflow by content-match; if the workflow node isn't on the grid yet those edges are silently omitted).
